text:
Fixed the ratio distribution bug in `rich/_ratio.py`.

Root cause: `ratio_distribute` accepted minimum widths but calculated allocations from the full available width without actually reserving those minimums. Small-ratio columns could therefore be reduced below their padding width.

The implementation now reserves each minimum width first, then distributes remaining space according to the ratios. Relevant tests pass.

final_text:
Fixed the ratio distribution bug in `rich/_ratio.py`.

Root cause: `ratio_distribute` accepted minimum widths but calculated allocations from the full available width without actually reserving those minimums. Small-ratio columns could therefore be reduced below their padding width.

The implementation now reserves each minimum width first, then distributes remaining space according to the ratios. Relevant tests pass.
